name: Cash Settlement
definition: Instruction between two financial institutions stipulating the cash transfer characteristics between the two parties.

InterbankSettlementAmount.name: Interbank Settlement Amount
InterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

CreditDateTime.name: Credit Date Time
CreditDateTime.definition: Information on the occurred settlement time(s) of the payment transaction for the credit side.

SettlementMethod.name: Settlement Method
SettlementMethod.definition: Method used to settle the (batch of) payment instructions.

DebitDateTime.name: Debit Date Time
DebitDateTime.definition: Information on the occurred settlement time(s) of the payment transaction for the debit side.

RelatedPaymentInstruction.name: Related Payment Instruction
RelatedPaymentInstruction.definition: PaymentInstruction which is the source of the settlement instruction.

SettlementAccount.name: Settlement Account
SettlementAccount.definition: A specific purpose account used to post debit and credit entries as a result of the transaction.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to the settlement of a payment and played by a party at that step in a payment flow.

RelatedTransactionAdministrator.name: Related Transaction Administrator
RelatedTransactionAdministrator.definition: Transaction administrator which manages the related settlement instructions.

BookEntry.name: Book Entry
BookEntry.definition: Movement of cash between two accounts in the same financial institution, resulting from the settlement of an instruction.

RelatedInvestigationCase.name: Related Investigation Case
RelatedInvestigationCase.definition: Case resolution which is the source of the correction of a settlement instruction.

Reservation.name: Reservation
Reservation.definition: Liquidity set aside by the payer for specific purposes.
